title: Impactful Dream Survey
content: So far we have had 196 responses to the survey we released a few months ago about impactful and/or recurring dreams. If you haven't taken the survey, you can take it here: [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfJ\_VS-4DXra-WmbM8p9Gq4ZKfkoATnGd2n4DWnvx2AH6Qy-g/viewform?usp=sharing](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfJ_VS-4DXra-WmbM8p9Gq4ZKfkoATnGd2n4DWnvx2AH6Qy-g/viewform?usp=sharing) Please do not share your email address or other identifying information in the survey as an overview of results will be visible to all respondents upon completion. Thank you all so much! Here is a link to the results. [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfJ\_VS-4DXra-WmbM8p9Gq4ZKfkoATnGd2n4DWnvx2AH6Qy-g/viewanalytics](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfJ_VS-4DXra-WmbM8p9Gq4ZKfkoATnGd2n4DWnvx2AH6Qy-g/viewanalytics)
